PROP-01b-partial3-inv-039.text: Flash loan cannot be used to manipulate oracle price within same transaction.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-039.assertion: forall flash_loan(user): oracle.getPrice uses TWAP or external feed, not spot AMM price

locations.note: Returns both EMA and spot price; EMA price is TWAP-like and manipulation-resistant. Borrow/withdraw safety check uses get_price_with_check which uses EMA
Returns EMA price (not spot) for general use in health checks, resistant to within-block flash manipulation
